thread:
olivia: quick heads-up — PR #4120 merged v2 response examples, but we didn't backport the quickstart page or the Go snippets. We should avoid a weird split for users hitting /quickstart

mike: yep noticed. also the model-swap doc still links to the old alias page, so redirects will mislead people. i can open a redirect ticket but docs should mention the alias->model-name change explicitly.

sam: i can take the Go samples. question: do we keep both v1 and v2 examples on the page (with a banner) or replace v1 entirely?

olivia: banner sounds safe for a few weeks. add a short migration note + tiny diff example so devs can scan quickly.

tara: small nit — the v2 SDK param rename is tripping people in the PR comments. example we used in JS: 
```
// v1 (old)
client.responses.create({ model: 'redwood-v1', input: 'hi' })

// v2 (new)
client.responses.create({ modelName: 'redwood-v2', prompt: 'hi' })
```
We should add that exact snippet to the migration guide.

mike: ^ do that but use neutral names like `example-model-1` in docs. also update snippet in /examples/embed-and-search — embeddings changed behavior slightly after the model swap so add a compat note.

docs-bot: Deploy preview for PR #4120 available: https://deploy-preview.redwood.dev/pr-4120 — checks: 18 passed, 2 warnings (link targets). :white_check_mark:

adele: i'll backport the TS snippets to /quickstart and add a short banner. ETA EOD today.

sam: i'll push Go samples tonight and add a tiny unit test harness for the example prompts (so we catch regressions after model swaps). what test vectors do we want?

tara: two prompts: one deterministic (math) and one open (summarization). small acceptance: summary > 20 chars, math exact match. put them in examples/tests/example_prompts.json and mention in the PR.

mike: i'll open infra ticket for the redirect (/models/alias -> /models/names) and attach a list of impacted doc links. will cc @oss-team for marketplace links.

olivia: great. checklist for PR authors: 1) add migration snippet (JS/TS/Go) 2) add quick banner on /quickstart 3) add test vectors + CI smoke test 4) update links & add redirect ticket number in PR body 5) mark docs owner for backport in the PR template.

adele: added checklist to PR #4120 comment. linking here: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4120#issuecomment-12345

docs-bot: Reminder: docs translation job queued for these pages. If backport lands after translations start, translations will be delayed.

sam: ack — i'll try to land before EOD to avoid that.

tara: small follow-up: can we add a one-line note in the model-swap page about tokenization differences for the new fallback model? we've had 2 support threads about unexpectedly longer token counts.

mike: yep i'll include a short example of token length diff.

olivia: thanks everyone. i'll triage remaining comments on #4120 in the morning. :thumbsup:

adele: done — assigning sam and tara as reviewers for the backport PRs.

mike: thanks — marking this thread resolved for tracking. :white_check_mark:
